stem.text: Which diagram shows the diffraction of water waves in a ripple tank?

A.alt: Vertical wavefronts travelling right from an arrow, a barrier with a single gap, and short straight wavefront segments drawn to the right of the gap.

B.alt: Vertical wavefronts travelling right from an arrow, a barrier with a single gap, and curved wavefronts drawn to the right of the gap, close to the barrier.

C.alt: Vertical wavefronts travelling right from an arrow, a barrier with a single gap, and arcs drawn to the right of the gap, centred on the gap.

D.alt: Vertical wavefronts travelling right from an arrow, a barrier with a single gap, and arcs drawn to the right of the gap.
